name: Custom TPC-H plan-comparison workload
index_assumption: Primary-key indexes only; no secondary indexes

queries.title: Customer primary-key lookup
queries.purpose: Provide a selective indexed-access baseline. Check whether both plans use the available customer primary-key index.

queries.title: Narrow order-key range
queries.purpose: Contrast with Q03 using identical projection and predicate shape but a much narrower key range.

queries.title: Broad order-key range
queries.purpose: Contrast with Q02 to test whether the AI assumes indexed access regardless of estimated selectivity. An index exists but need not be selected.

queries.title: Combined non-indexed part filters
queries.purpose: Exercise combined filters and check for AI proposals that rely on unavailable secondary indexes.

queries.title: Customer/order join with selective filters
queries.purpose: Exercise join-method and input-side choices when a small customer range is joined to filtered orders.

queries.title: Filtered customer/order/lineitem chain
queries.purpose: Exercise alternative join orders and filter placement with conditions on all three relations.

queries.title: Regional supplier inventory chain
queries.purpose: Exercise join order across region, nation, supplier and partsupp, including very small dimension tables.

queries.title: Shipping-mode and return-flag totals
queries.purpose: Exercise grouping strategy and possible partial/final aggregation or parallel-plan details.

queries.title: Supplier stock thresholds
queries.purpose: Distinguish filtering input rows with WHERE from filtering aggregate results with HAVING.

queries.title: Most expensive medium-sized parts
queries.purpose: Exercise ordering and limiting when the ordering columns do not have a matching index. Plain EXPLAIN does not confirm a runtime top-N sort algorithm.

queries.title: Distinct nation/segment combinations
queries.purpose: Exercise duplicate elimination and possible hash-based versus sort-based strategies.

queries.title: Customers with qualifying monthly orders
queries.purpose: Check how existence testing is represented, including optimizer rewrites that need not preserve the SQL subquery shape.

queries.title: Suppliers without critically low stock
queries.purpose: Exercise anti-join semantics without the NULL-sensitive behaviour of NOT IN.

queries.title: Parts priced above a reference average
queries.purpose: Exercise an independently computed scalar aggregate and possible InitPlan representation.

queries.title: Customers above their peer-group average
queries.purpose: Exercise outer-variable references and possible repeated SubPlan evaluation. The outer key range bounds the number of candidate customers.

queries.title: Materialized yearly customer totals
queries.purpose: Exercise explicit CTE materialisation, CTE scans and named intermediate results. MATERIALIZED is intentional, rather than relying on the optimizer to retain a plain CTE.

queries.title: Customer order counts including zero matches
queries.purpose: Check preservation of customers without matching orders. The date filter stays in ON, and COUNT(o_orderkey) yields zero for unmatched customers.

queries.title: Supplier price comparisons for the same part
queries.purpose: Exercise alias-aware matching for two scans of partsupp. The supplier inequality avoids self-pairs and symmetric duplicates.

queries.title: High-balance customer and supplier accounts
queries.purpose: Exercise a branching append-style plan without requesting duplicate elimination.

queries.title: Rank each customer's recent orders
queries.purpose: Exercise WindowAgg and required input ordering. Window ordering does not itself promise a globally ordered query result.
